item.title: Downtown Kansas City hotel rooms back on the market for World Cup dates
item.description: Prior to the World Cup, FIFA secured more rooms than needed in each city, with the understanding that they will confirm the final number of rooms at least 120 days before the tournament starts. Now that the 120 window has passed, many Kansas City hotels are back on the market.

item.title: 17-year-old tiger dies at Sedgwick County Zoo
item.description: The zoo said the tiger battled a musculoskeletal condition. The disease was getting worse, and because he was so old, the zoo said this was the "compassionate decision."

item.title: Judge lets teen be charged as adult in 2025 Towne East shooting
item.description: The teen is facing two counts of attempted first-degree murder, two counts of aggravated battery and one count of criminal use of a weapon.

item.title: Three Oklahoma firefighters seriously injured in crash into canyon during wildfire
item.description: The Oklahoma Highway Patrol said the smoke was so thick, the driver couldn't see through it. The truck went into a burning canyon and overturned.

item.title: ‘An incredible moment’: Wichita Fire helps son visit injured firefighter in hospital
item.description: Amid days of intense wildfire battles across Kansas, a moment of compassion stood out.

item.title: Ashland rancher loses hundreds of cattle in Ranger Road Fire
item.description: So far, nearly 300,000 acres of land have been burned in the Ranger Road Fire. Across the plains of rural southwest Kansas, thousands of heads of cattle graze.

item.title: Kansas fire departments on high alert amid rising fire risks
item.description: It means that fire departments are immediately sent to any wildland fire.

item.title: Kansas volunteer firefighters express gratitude for community support
item.description: Many volunteer fire departments are thanking their communities on Thursday for their support in the wake of this week's extreme fire conditions.

item.title: Silver Alert issued for missing Wichita man
item.description: The Wichita Police Department is seeking the public's help in locating a missing 70-year-old man.

item.title: Storm Track 3 Forecast: Fire danger decreasing, rain and snow showers Friday
item.description: Chief Meteorologist Lisa Teachman says winter is back through the weekend with a few pockets of snow on Friday. Fire danger takes a hiatus, but may be able to return next week.
